system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose one accessible magical item. Study the item and make a Knowledge roll. On a Standard result, learn its functions, activation requirements and the triggers of any curse.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible magical item.
Type
Skill / Utility

Study the item and make a Knowledge roll.

Weak
Learn its broad purpose and whether activating it carries a curse or harmful effect.
Standard
Learn its functions, activation requirements and the triggers of any curse.
Strong
Also learn a specific way to suppress or remove a curse it carries, if such a remedy exists.
